issues.description: The mapping proof manufactures a second initialized metadata-slot permission with an axiom and inserts it into the region map instead of transferring the existing linear permission.
issues.rationale: entry_owner already represents the tracked mapping and carries its frame's slot permission, but this proof calls placeholder_slot_perm to axiomatically create another initialized PointsTo for the same metadata address, then inserts it into regions.slots solely to satisfy item_slot_in_regions. Because the axiom consumes no permission token, the proof bypasses the intended linear ownership discipline and can establish mutually independent authority over one slot. The initial report was AI-assisted, but collaborator SNoAnd independently confirmed that proofs using placeholder_slot_perm were questionable, described it as a temporary gap that should be deprecated, and the PR author later declared this old revision no longer valid before replacing the branch.
